title: Senator Tammy Baldwin takes issue with Packers Thanksgiving Eve game on Netflix

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Senator Tammy Baldwin takes issue with Packers Thanksgiving Eve game on Netflix
sources.description: Last month, Senator Tammy Baldwin (D-WI) introduced legislation aimed at ensuring free, over-the-air access by citizens of a given state to all nationally-televised games involving the teams headquartered there.
